title.en: Shaman Talents Revisited Early Next Year - Blizzard Addresses Shaman Classic Discord Shutdown in WoW: Forever
title.es: Talentos de Chamán revisitados a principios del próximo año: Blizzard aborda el cierre de la discordia clásica de Chamán en WoW: Forever

summary.en: Shaman Talents Revisited Early Next Year - Blizzard Addresses Shaman Classic Discord Shutdown in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Talentos de Chamán revisitados a principios del próximo año - Blizzard aborda el cierre de la discordia clásica de Chamán en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has addressed the Shaman Classic Discord shutdown, noting that they are looking at revisiting Shaman talents, but no sooner than early next year.

Elemental Shaman GuideEnhancement Shaman Guide


Earlier this week, before the WoW: Forever launch, the Shaman Classic Discord shut down in protest of "how the developers are approaching all Shaman specs in WoW Forever."

In a recent interview with Crix, Kris Zierhut addresses the shutdown and gives his thoughts on the current state of Shaman and what the future for Shamans could be.
Kris Zierhut said:
I think some of their issues are legitimate and some of them are that they're mad they can't have improved Ghost Wolf.
Kris goes on to discuss how they're looking particularly hard at Enhancement, as they're being pushed towards wanting too much spell power gear. Enhancement Shamans should want to wear Strength, Intellect, and Spell Power, similar to Ret Paladins. They do not want Enhancement to run around in Cloth Robes.

He also comments on the state of Elemental, as they're watching it really closely. Kris made the last-minute call as he heard that players don't like Lava Burst and they wanted more powerful Chain Lightning, but he admits it could've used a little more "cook".
Kris Zierhut said:
[...]I wouldn't be surprised if early next year we revisit Shaman talents a little bit. It's not going to be sooner than that. It's going to be a Patch.
Shaman Talents look to be revisited early next year, but in the meantime, Kris does mention that there will be some tuning once they get raid data. Other than that, Shaman (and Druid) talents are on the radar for getting changed early next year.

contentHtml:
Blizzard has released a new issue of their WoW Weekly blog post, recapping the Forever launch, Discord integration, and the reveal of a new Forever Legendary weapon.
Blizzard
View Original
Azeroth has a new home, and the adventure is just getting started! This week in WoW Weekly, discover that World of Warcraft: Forever is now live, join the ongoing conversations on Discord both in and out of the game, explore another way to play with gamepad support, and more.

World of Warcraft: Forever Now Live!


Whether you’re stepping into World of Warcraft for the first time or finding your way back to Azeroth, there’s a place for you in World of Warcraft: Forever. Explore a new and reimagined Azeroth at your own pace, discover new places or revisit old favorites, and meet fellow adventurers along the way. This permanent home alongside modern and Classic WoW puts community first and makes the journey as meaningful as the destination.
Click to Learn More

WoW: Forever—What’s New and What Feels Familiar


From a well-fought battle to a look that feels uniquely yours, the moments that matter in WoW are personal. World of Warcraft: Forever gives you another setting for those interests, whether you play the modern game, prefer Classic, haven’t logged in for a while, or are getting to know Warcraft for the first time.

Here’s a look at the controls, content, and character choices that can help you decide what you’d like to try.
Click to Learn More

Stay Connected in World of Warcraft with Discord


Keep the conversation going in modern World of Warcraft and World of Warcraft: Forever with Discord account linking and guild chat mirroring. Whether you’re coordinating your next raid run, recruiting more players for PvP, or catching up with your guildmates, you can send messages between Discord and your guild chat.

Your next adventure starts with a conversation. Link your accounts, rally your guild, and stay connected wherever your journey takes you.
Click to Learn More

Explore WoW: Forever with a Gamepad


A spell to cast, an ally to heal, a well-earned reward to collect—there’s plenty to keep you busy in Azeroth. If you prefer a gamepad, World of Warcraft: Forever gives you another way to join the action.

In World of Warcraft: Forever, we’ve refined targeting, casting, looting, and menu navigation for gamepads while keeping the familiar feel players have come to know.
Click to Learn More

Set Your Campfire Ablaze with the Pouch of Violet Dust!


Watch any eligible World of Warcraft streams on Twitch.tv to claim the Pouch of Violet Dust toy to enhance your campfire and spread the benefits of camaraderie in World of Warcraft: Forever.

Start Time : November 4, at 4:30 pm PST
End Time : November 12, at 4:30 pm PST

This ephemeral item is only available in WoW: Forever and can only be used during the “WoW: Forever Launch Celebration” event period, after which the toy will be removed from players’ collections and will no longer be available in-game.

Click the button for more details, FAQs, and how to link your Twitch account.
Click to Learn More

WoW: Forever– Watch Forging Forever

Witness the creation of World of Warcraft: Forever's first legendary: Taldramir, the Whispering Wood, forged by Wētā, wielded by adventurers like you.
Let us journey alongside you, regale you with tales of adventure in faraway places, map out roads less traveled, and direct your gaze toward the legendary challenges that await. Return each week to the World of Warcraft news site, where we'll uncover your destiny together.

title.es: Ula 'tek Nerfed en todas las dificultades - Correcciones en Vivo (Hotfixes) ahora en vivo

summary.en: Ula'tek Nerfed on All Difficulties - Hotfixes Now Live...
summary.es: Ula 'tek Nerfed on All Difficulties - Correcciones en Vivo (Hotfixes) Now Live...

contentHtml:
Ula'tek has just been officially hotfixed, with nerfs to the encounter on all difficulties.

Ula'tek


While the Patch notes were not very specific about certain abilities, we've confirmed the following from datamining:
  • Serpent's Bite (Red Soaks) reduced to 2 players (was 3) on all difficulties.
  • Grasping Fangs (Tethers) reduced to 2 players (was 3) on Normal and Heroic.
Here are the official notes from yesterday's tuning announcement.
Blizzard
View Original
  • Ula’tek
    • Adjusted the health scaling on the following enemies on Raid Finder, Normal, and Heroic difficulties to better account for smaller raid sizes. Their base health has also been reduced on these difficulties to ensure the health scaling does not increase their health with larger raid sizes.
      • Ula’tek
      • Blightsclae Rawling
      • Blightscale Viper
      • Blightscale Shrieker
      • Weakened Doomscale
    • Ula’tek health reduced by 15% on Heroic difficulty.
    • Unchecked Rage damage reduced by 61% on all difficulties.
    • Caustic Waves impact damage reduced by 17% on Heroic and Mythic difficulties.
    • Caustic Waves damage over time reduced by 75% on Normal, 61% on Heroic, and 89% on Mythic difficulties.
    • Malice damage reduced by 63% on Normal and Heroic difficulty, and 45% on Mythic difficulty.
    • Virulent Spit damage reduced by 46% on Raid Finder, 33% on Normal and Heroic, and 36% on Mythic difficulties.
    • Falling Debris damage reduced by 46% on Raid Finder, 33% on Normal and Heroic, and 36% on Mythic difficulties.
    • Viscous Echoes impact damage reduced by 53% and damage over time reduced by 25% on all difficulties.
    • Reduced the number of eggs summoned by Call of the Serpent on Normal and Heroic difficulty.
    • Reduced the number of targets selected by Serpent’s Bite on all difficulties.
    • Reduced the number of targets selected by Grasping Fangs on Normal and Heroic difficulty.
    • Removed 2 eggs from each side during Phase 2, reducing the total to 8 eggs per side on Heroic difficulty.
    • Ula’tek no longer generates additional Caustic Waves from Spectral Tails when sending walls of waves across the platforms during Phase 3 on Heroic difficulty.
    • Noxious Splash initial damage reduced by 33% and damage over time reduced by 84% on Mythic difficulty.
    • Putrid Membrane duration reduced to 20 seconds (was 30 seconds) on Mythic difficulty.

title.en: Major QoL Update to Popular Alliance Quest in WoW: Forever
title.es: Actualización importante de la calidad de vida de Popular Alliance Quest en WoW: Forever

summary.en: Major QoL Update to Popular Alliance Quest in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Actualización importante de la calidad de vida de Popular Alliance Quest en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
In WoW: Forever, the iconic Alliance quest, The Attack!, has received some major quality-of-life updates, allowing players to complete this quest with much less frustration and downtime.



Prior to WoW: Forever, players starting this quest would automatically trigger the event, and only players nearby in that person's party would be able to accept the quest with them. In WoW: Forever, there is an additional dialogue option after starting the quest to make sure everyone in your party is ready!


Along with that, players can now pick up the quest and share it even as the event is happening. In Classic WoW, anyone interested in doing this quest would have to wait for the event to be completed before they and their party could start, often causing long queues and lines as players got to this quest chain. Now groups can pick up additional players should they have room, and anyone can pick up the quest even as the event is happening!



Alliance players no longer have to wait for excruciating time periods to get their coveted Seal of Wrynn, as they progress in their leveling journey.

contentHtml:
Dungeons are a great source of experience, but only if you have dungeon quests. Here's where to find all the dungeon quests for the first few dungeons.

Every Dungeon Quest Location


In WoW: Forever, base dungeon experience from killing mobs has been nerfed, but experience from completing dungeon quests has been buffed. Completing Dungeon Quests is very important, as without them, you won't be getting all the possible experience (or even the majority of it) from a given dungeon.

Below, you'll find the available quests for every dungeon, where to pick them up, the estimated amount of time to get them, and any prerequisite questing that you need to do. Many of these quests are shareable, so if one person in the group has it, they can share it with the rest of the party!
